verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. Same decay shape C·(1+|x|+t)^{-k}, a different constant. The paper's constant is explicit — M_{α,m}(3+R)^k with M_{α,m} = ‖∂_x^α ∂_t^m f‖_∞ and 𝒦 ⊂ B(0,R), coming from 1+|x|+t ≤ 3+R on the support 𝒦 × [0,2]. Lean's C is only existentially quantified and is produced by compactness of Icc 0 (T+1) ×ˢ S (jet_decay lines 65–67), with no stated dependence on R or on ‖∂^α_x ∂^m_t f‖_∞; in that respect it is less informative than the display. In the other direction the Lean statement is more general: the exponent K ranges over all reals rather than integers k ≥ 0, and the left side is the norm of the whole one-sided jet tensor of total order m (all mixed space-time derivatives at once) rather than a single ∂_x^α ∂_t^m component. Both hold for t ≥ 0 only, matching the use the paper makes of the display, namely Fefferman's decay condition (5), which is the `decay` field of Comparator.ForceConditionDecay and asks exactly for an existential C. Searched for the explicit (3+R)^k form and found no declaration carrying it.
